circuit:
* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC - SKY130 1.8 V
* Architecture:
*   - 16-segment resistor ladder vrefn..vrefp gives taps vt1..vt15 (0.1125 V/step)
*   - 15 switched-capacitor comparators: during clk=0 the input pair is tracked
*     onto series caps with the compare nodes clamped to vb=0.9 V (bottom-plate
*     sampling); on the rising clk edge the clamps open first, then the cap
*     bottom plates switch to ladder taps (vt_j, vt_16-j), producing
*     xn-xp = alpha*[(vinp-vinn)-(vt_j-vt_16-j)] at a fixed 0.9 V common mode.
*   - StrongARM latch (delayed conversion strobe) + NAND SR latch per comparator
*   - Non-overlapping phase generator derived from the single external clk
*   - Static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder
*
* Primitive examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------- logic primitives ----------------
.subckt fadc_inv1 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fadc_inv1

.subckt fadc_inv4 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends fadc_inv4

.subckt fadc_inv8 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends fadc_inv8

.subckt fadc_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XN1 y a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fadc_nand2

.subckt fadc_nand4 a b c d y vss vdd
XN1 y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN3 m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN4 m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fadc_nand4

.subckt fadc_nor2 a b y vss vdd
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP1 mid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 y b mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fadc_nor2

* transmission gate: conducts when gn=1 / gp=0
.subckt fadc_tg a b gn gp vss vdd
XN a gn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP a gp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fadc_tg

* ---------------- StrongARM latch ----------------
* Precharge (both outputs high) while ck=0; on ck=1 the output on the side of
* the HIGHER input (inp side = oa) goes low.
.subckt fadc_salatch inp inn ck oa ob vss vdd
XMT tl ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM1 ma inp tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM2 mb inn tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM3 oa ob ma vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM4 ob oa mb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM5 oa ob vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM6 ob oa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPC1 oa ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPC2 ob ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPC3 ma ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPC4 mb ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fadc_salatch

* ---------------- comparator slice ----------------
* Thermometer bit t = 1 when (vip - vin) > (tp - tn)
.subckt fadc_cmp vip vin tp tn vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck t vss vdd
* input tracking switches (acquisition, p1d)
XTI1 lpp vip p1d p1db vss vdd fadc_tg
XTI2 lpn vin p1d p1db vss vdd fadc_tg
* reference switches (conversion, p2)
XTR1 lpp tp p2 p2b vss vdd fadc_tg
XTR2 lpn tn p2 p2b vss vdd fadc_tg
* sampling caps and attenuator caps
CS1 lpp xp 40f
CS2 lpn xn 40f
CA1 xp vss 40f
CA2 xn vss 40f
* clamp switches to vb (early phase p1e -> bottom-plate sampling)
XTC1 xp vb p1e p1eb vss vdd fadc_tg
XTC2 xn vb p1e p1eb vss vdd fadc_tg
* regenerative latch: xn > xp means code above threshold -> oa low
XSA xn xp sck oa ob vss vdd fadc_salatch
* NAND SR latch: t set high when oa pulses low
XG1 oa qb t vss vdd fadc_nand2
XG2 ob t qb vss vdd fadc_nand2
.ends fadc_cmp

* ---------------- clock/phase generator ----------------
* p1e/p1eb : clamp phase, first to open on rising clk (defines sample instant)
* p1d/p1db : input tracking phase, opens two gate delays later
* p2/p2b   : reference phase, non-overlapping with p1d
* sck      : delayed StrongARM strobe (roughly 1 ns after p2 rises)
.subckt fadc_ckgen clk p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck vss vdd
Xi0 clk cb0 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xi1 cb0 c vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xi2 c cb vss vdd fadc_inv1
* phase-1 side: active when clk low, disabled only after p2 has fallen
Xn1 cb fb2 nn1 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xp1 nn1 p1x vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xb1 p1x p1eb vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xb2 p1eb p1e vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xd1 p1x d1a vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xd2 d1a p1dr vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xb3 p1dr p1db vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xb4 p1db p1d vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xf1 p1d fb1 vss vdd fadc_inv1
* phase-2 side: active when clk high, enabled only after p1d has fallen
Xn2 c fb1 nn2 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xp2 nn2 p2x vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xb5 p2x p2b vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xb6 p2b p2 vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xf2 p2 fb2 vss vdd fadc_inv1
* delayed StrongARM strobe (6 inversions + RC delay keeps polarity of p2)
Xs1 p2 s1 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xs2 s1 s2 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xs3 s2 s3 vss vdd fadc_inv1
CD1 s3 vss 150f
Xs4 s3 s4 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xs5 s4 s5 vss vdd fadc_inv4
Xs6 s5 sck vss vdd fadc_inv8
.ends fadc_ckgen

* ---------------- thermometer-to-binary encoder ----------------
* d3 = t8
* d2 = t12 + t4*~t8
* d1 = t14 + t10*~t12 + t6*~t8 + t2*~t4
* d0 = t15 + t13*~t14 + t11*~t12 + t9*~t10 + t7*~t8 + t5*~t6 + t3*~t4 + t1*~t2
.subckt fadc_enc t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 t8 t9 t10 t11 t12 t13 t14 t15 d3 d2 d1 d0 vss vdd
Xn2 t2 nb2 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xn4 t4 nb4 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xn6 t6 nb6 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xn8 t8 nb8 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xn10 t10 nb10 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xn12 t12 nb12 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xn14 t14 nb14 vss vdd fadc_inv1
* d3
Xd3a t8 d3n vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xd3b d3n d3 vss vdd fadc_inv4
* d2
Xa1 t4 nb8 a1 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xa2 a1 nb12 d2p vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xd2a d2p d2n vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xd2b d2n d2 vss vdd fadc_inv4
* d1
Xu1 t2 nb4 u1 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xu2 t6 nb8 u2 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xu3 t10 nb12 u3 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xu4 t14 u4 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xd1x u1 u2 u3 u4 d1p vss vdd fadc_nand4
Xd1a d1p d1n vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xd1b d1n d1 vss vdd fadc_inv4
* d0
Xq1 t1 nb2 q1 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq2 t3 nb4 q2 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq3 t5 nb6 q3 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq4 t7 nb8 q4 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq5 t9 nb10 q5 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq6 t11 nb12 q6 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq7 t13 nb14 q7 vss vdd fadc_nand2
Xq8 t15 q8 vss vdd fadc_inv1
Xy1 q1 q2 q3 q4 y1 vss vdd fadc_nand4
Xy2 q5 q6 q7 q8 y2 vss vdd fadc_nand4
Xz y1 y2 d0nn vss vdd fadc_nor2
Xd0b d0nn d0 vss vdd fadc_inv4
.ends fadc_enc

* ---------------- top level ----------------
.subckt flash_adc_4bit clk dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* reference ladder: vt_j = vrefn + j*(vrefp-vrefn)/16
RL0 vt1 vrefn 500
RL1 vt2 vt1 500
RL2 vt3 vt2 500
RL3 vt4 vt3 500
RL4 vt5 vt4 500
RL5 vt6 vt5 500
RL6 vt7 vt6 500
RL7 vt8 vt7 500
RL8 vt9 vt8 500
RL9 vt10 vt9 500
RL10 vt11 vt10 500
RL11 vt12 vt11 500
RL12 vt13 vt12 500
RL13 vt14 vt13 500
RL14 vt15 vt14 500
RL15 vrefp vt15 500
* clamp common-mode rail (0.9 V)
RB1 vdd vb 5k
RB2 vb vss 5k
CB1 vb vss 2p
* clock phases
XCKG clk p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck vss vdd fadc_ckgen
* comparator bank: threshold_j = vt_j - vt_(16-j) = 0.225*j - 1.8 (differential)
XC1 vinp vinn vt1 vt15 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc1 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC2 vinp vinn vt2 vt14 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc2 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC3 vinp vinn vt3 vt13 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc3 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC4 vinp vinn vt4 vt12 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc4 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC5 vinp vinn vt5 vt11 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc5 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC6 vinp vinn vt6 vt10 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc6 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC7 vinp vinn vt7 vt9 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc7 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC8 vinp vinn vt8 vt8 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc8 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC9 vinp vinn vt9 vt7 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc9 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC10 vinp vinn vt10 vt6 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc10 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC11 vinp vinn vt11 vt5 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc11 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC12 vinp vinn vt12 vt4 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc12 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC13 vinp vinn vt13 vt3 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc13 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC14 vinp vinn vt14 vt2 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc14 vss vdd fadc_cmp
XC15 vinp vinn vt15 vt1 vb p1e p1eb p1d p1db p2 p2b sck tc15 vss vdd fadc_cmp
* binary encoder
XENC tc1 tc2 tc3 tc4 tc5 tc6 tc7 tc8 tc9 tc10 tc11 tc12 tc13 tc14 tc15 dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd fadc_enc
.ends flash_adc_4bit

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (sky130 TT, 1.8 V)
* Architecture:
*   - 16-segment resistor reference ladder vrefn..vrefp, taps r1..r15 at 0.1125*k V
*   - 15 differential-difference StrongARM comparator slices:
*       slice k decides sign of (vinp-vinn) - (r_k - r_(16-k))  -> thermometer t_k
*   - NAND SR latch per slice holds decision during precharge phase
*   - Transmission-gate binary-search encoder: thermometer -> binary
*   - Internal clock buffer chain generates complementary/buffered sample clocks
*
* Helper subcircuits -----------------------------------------------------

.subckt fa_inv_s a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fa_inv_s

.subckt fa_inv_m a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends fa_inv_m

.subckt fa_inv_l a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=18 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1
.ends fa_inv_l

.subckt fa_inv_x a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=54 nf=6
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=27 nf=3
.ends fa_inv_x

.subckt fa_inv_b a y vss vdd
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends fa_inv_b

.subckt fa_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fa_nand2

* 2:1 transmission-gate mux: y = s ? d1 : d0 (sb = complement of s)
.subckt fa_mux2 d0 d1 s sb y vss vdd
XN0 y sb d0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP0 y s d0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 y s d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 y sb d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fa_mux2

* Differential-difference StrongARM comparator + NAND SR latch.
* Evaluates on ck rising edge; q -> 1 when (vip-vin) > (vra-vrb).
.subckt fa_cmp ck vip vin vra vrb q qb vss vdd
* input pair A (vip vs vra), weak tail current source switched by ck
XM1 dx vip sa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM2 dy vra sa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTA sa ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=0.6 nf=1
* input pair B (vrb vs vin), weak tail current source switched by ck
XM3 dx vrb sb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM4 dy vin sb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTB sb ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=0.6 nf=1
* integration caps: let the differential develop before regeneration
CIX dx vss 20f
CIY dy vss 20f
COX ox vss 10f
COY oy vss 10f
* regenerative cross-coupled core
XC1 ox oy dx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XC2 oy ox dy vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XR1 ox oy vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XR2 oy ox vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* precharge switches (active while ck low)
XQ1 ox ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XQ2 oy ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XQ3 dx ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XQ4 dy ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* SR latch: ox falling sets q=1, oy falling sets q=0
XSR1 ox qb q vss vdd fa_nand2
XSR2 oy q qb vss vdd fa_nand2
.ends fa_cmp

* DUT --------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt flash_adc_4bit clk dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* clock buffer chain: cki is buffered in-phase sample clock,
* ckb1/ckb2 are the internally generated complementary clocks
XCK1 clk ckb1 vss vdd fa_inv_s
XCK2 ckb1 ck1 vss vdd fa_inv_m
XCK3 ck1 ckb2 vss vdd fa_inv_l
XCK4 ckb2 cki vss vdd fa_inv_x

* reference ladder: 16 x 500 ohm, taps r1..r15 with decoupling caps
RL00 vrefn r1 500
RL01 r1 r2 500
RL02 r2 r3 500
RL03 r3 r4 500
RL04 r4 r5 500
RL05 r5 r6 500
RL06 r6 r7 500
RL07 r7 r8 500
RL08 r8 r9 500
RL09 r9 r10 500
RL10 r10 r11 500
RL11 r11 r12 500
RL12 r12 r13 500
RL13 r13 r14 500
RL14 r14 r15 500
RL15 r15 vrefp 500
CD01 r1 vss 2p
CD02 r2 vss 2p
CD03 r3 vss 2p
CD04 r4 vss 2p
CD05 r5 vss 2p
CD06 r6 vss 2p
CD07 r7 vss 2p
CD08 r8 vss 2p
CD09 r9 vss 2p
CD10 r10 vss 2p
CD11 r11 vss 2p
CD12 r12 vss 2p
CD13 r13 vss 2p
CD14 r14 vss 2p
CD15 r15 vss 2p

* comparator bank: slice k threshold = (r_k - r_(16-k)) differential
XC01 cki vinp vinn r1 r15 t1 tb1 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC02 cki vinp vinn r2 r14 t2 tb2 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC03 cki vinp vinn r3 r13 t3 tb3 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC04 cki vinp vinn r4 r12 t4 tb4 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC05 cki vinp vinn r5 r11 t5 tb5 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC06 cki vinp vinn r6 r10 t6 tb6 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC07 cki vinp vinn r7 r9 t7 tb7 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC08 cki vinp vinn r8 r8 t8 tb8 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC09 cki vinp vinn r9 r7 t9 tb9 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC10 cki vinp vinn r10 r6 t10 tb10 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC11 cki vinp vinn r11 r5 t11 tb11 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC12 cki vinp vinn r12 r4 t12 tb12 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC13 cki vinp vinn r13 r3 t13 tb13 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC14 cki vinp vinn r14 r2 t14 tb14 vss vdd fa_cmp
XC15 cki vinp vinn r15 r1 t15 tb15 vss vdd fa_cmp

* binary-search encoder (clean thermometer): b3=t8, then mux halves
* b2 = t8 ? t12 : t4
XE2M t4 t12 t8 tb8 b2m vss vdd fa_mux2
XE2A b2m b2n vss vdd fa_inv_m
XE2B b2n b2p vss vdd fa_inv_m
* b1 = select among t2,t6,t10,t14 by (t8, b2)
XE1A t2 t6 b2p b2n m1lo vss vdd fa_mux2
XE1B t10 t14 b2p b2n m1hi vss vdd fa_mux2
XE1C m1lo m1hi t8 tb8 b1m vss vdd fa_mux2
XE1D b1m b1n vss vdd fa_inv_m
XE1E b1n b1p vss vdd fa_inv_m
* b0 = select among odd taps by (t8, b2, b1)
XE0A t1 t3 b1p b1n xa vss vdd fa_mux2
XE0B t5 t7 b1p b1n xb vss vdd fa_mux2
XE0C t9 t11 b1p b1n xc vss vdd fa_mux2
XE0D t13 t15 b1p b1n xd vss vdd fa_mux2
XE0E xa xb b2p b2n xe vss vdd fa_mux2
XE0F xc xd b2p b2n xf vss vdd fa_mux2
XE0G xe xf t8 tb8 b0m vss vdd fa_mux2

* =====================================================================
* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC - SKY130 1.8 V core
* =====================================================================
* Architecture
*   * 16-segment reference ladder between vrefn and vrefp produces taps
*     t(m) = 0.1125*m V, m = 1..15.
*   * Each of the 15 comparators is preceded by a 2:1 resistive summing
*     network that forms
*         va(m) = ( vinp + t(16-m) ) / 2
*         vb(m) = ( vinn + t(m)    ) / 2
*     so that  va - vb = ( (vinp-vinn) - 0.225*(m-8) ) / 2 .
*     Comparator m therefore trips at vdiff = 0.225*(m-8) V, giving the
*     15 thresholds -1.575 .. +1.575 V on a 0.225 V (1 LSB) grid, i.e.
*     exactly half an LSB below/above the specified code centres.
*     Because vinp + vinn = 1.8 V, va + vb = 1.8 V as well: at every
*     threshold crossing both comparator inputs sit at exactly 0.9 V and
*     both see the same source impedance, so the decision level is set
*     purely by matched geometry.
*   * The summing network loads tap m with a signal independent current
*     (t(m)-0.9)/200k.  The ladder segment values below are solved for
*     that load, so the loaded taps land exactly on the 0.1125 V grid.
*   * Comparators are clocked StrongARM latches: clk = 0 resets/acquires,
*     the rising edge ends sampling and starts regeneration, clk = 1 is
*     the conversion phase.  A NAND SR latch holds the thermometer bit
*     through the following reset phase.  The full reset of all four
*     dynamic nodes every cycle removes decision hysteresis.
*   * The complementary sample clock (clkb) is generated on chip by the
*     internal clock buffer chain; only the single external clk pin is
*     used.
*   * Thermometer-to-binary conversion is transistor-level static CMOS.
* =====================================================================

* =============================================================================
* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC  (SKY130, 1.8 V, 27 C)
*
* Architecture
*   - 16-segment reference ladder between vrefn and vrefp gives taps
*     rt<m> = m*Vref/16.  Comparator j uses rt<j> and rt<16-j> so that its
*     differential threshold is  vth_j = rt<j> - rt<16-j> = 0.225*j - 1.8 V.
*   - Each comparator has a resistive averaging front end:
*         ap_j = (vinp + rt<16-j>)/2 ,  an_j = (vinn + rt<j>)/2
*     so  ap_j - an_j = ( (vinp-vinn) - vth_j ) / 2  and the pair common mode
*     is always 0.9 V.  The zero crossing of ap-an is exactly the threshold,
*     independent of comparator nonlinearity, and the wide +/-1.7 V input
*     range never saturates the comparison (only its gain).
*   - Clocked StrongARM latch per comparator: clk = 0 resets/acquires,
*     the rising edge ends sampling, clk = 1 regenerates.  A NAND SR latch
*     holds the thermometer bit (and its complement) for the whole period.
*   - Transistor-level static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder.
*   - The complementary sample clock ckb is generated internally from clk.
* =============================================================================

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (SKY130, 1.8 V)
*
* Architecture
*   - 16-segment resistor ladder between vrefn and vrefp; tap(j) = j/16*(vrefp-vrefn).
*   - 15 four-input StrongARM comparators. Comparator k (k=1..15) decides
*       vinp + tap(16-k) > vinn + tap(k)  <=>  vinp-vinn > tap(k)-tap(16-k) = (k-8)*LSB
*     At threshold both halves see the identical gate-voltage pair
*     {tap(k), tap(16-k)}, so the trip point is set by symmetry, not by device
*     linearity, over the full rail-to-rail input range.
*   - clk=0: comparators reset (acquisition), rising edge: regenerative decision,
*     buffered NOR SR latch holds the thermometer bit (and its complement) for
*     the cycle.
*   - Static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder:
*       b3 = T8
*       b2 = T12 + T4.T8'
*       b1 = T14 + T10.T12' + T6.T8' + T2.T4'
*       b0 = T15 + T13.T14' + T11.T12' + T9.T10' + T7.T8' + T5.T6' + T3.T4' + T1.T2'

* ==========================================================================
*  4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC   (sky130 1.8 V devices, TT)
*
*  clk = 0 : acquisition (track)
*  clk = 1 : conversion
*
*  Signal path
*    vinp/vinn -- resistive 0.2x attenuator about 0.9 V --> global track&hold
*    --> 15 clocked comparators (resistive-load preamp + isolating pass gate
*        + cross-coupled regenerative latch)
*    --> thermometer-to-binary static CMOS encoder --> dout3..dout0
*
*  Reference: 16-resistor string from vrefp to vrefn.  The taps are the
*  attenuated replica of the comparator thresholds, so the attenuator ratio
*  and the ladder geometry set the transfer curve ratiometrically.  Tap m
*  sits at 0.72 + 0.0225*m, i.e. 0.9 + 0.2*(0.1125*m - 0.9): comparator m
*  trips when vinp = 0.1125*m, which puts the code-k centre at
*  0.05625 + 0.1125*k for k = 0..15.  Node n8 is the 0.9 V ladder midpoint
*  and also the attenuator return.  Because the two attenuators are driven
*  complementarily (vinp + vinn = 1.8 in every operating mode) their
*  currents into n8 cancel exactly, so the ladder carries only its own
*  225 uA and the 0.2 ratio holds without a buffer.
*
*  The complementary sample clock is generated on chip by XCI; the
*  comparator preamps, the latch reset device and every encoder gate are
*  all clocked from clk/clkb, so no second external clock is needed.
*
*  Comparator sizing note: with a resistive tail the preamp's differential
*  transconductance saturates near 1/RT, so RT is what sets the available
*  gain; the pair width then only has to be wide enough to reach it.  RT is
*  chosen together with the load resistors so that the preamp output common
*  mode stays near 1.0..1.6 V over the whole input range (it is
*  1.8 - I_tail*R_load/2), and the pair is kept at w=16 to hold its
*  gate-drain overlap capacitance - and hence the kick it couples back onto
*  the held input - small.
*
*  Every encoder gate carries clk in series with its pull-down stack so that
*  the whole encoder is parked at a rail while the comparators track; this
*  keeps the mid-rail latch outputs from crowbarring the static CMOS gates
*  during acquisition, which would otherwise dominate the supply current.
* ==========================================================================

* CMOS inverter

*   vin  : held (attenuated) positive input
*   vref : ladder tap  (tap m corresponds to threshold code m)
*   vout : thermometer true  (high when vin > vref)
*   voutb: thermometer complement
*
*   preamp : NMOS pair with resistive tail and resistive loads
*   passgate: connects the preamp outputs to the latch while clk = 0
*   latch  : cross-coupled NMOS pair, enabled while clk = 1
*   XM9    : keeps the latch tail at vdd while clk = 0 so the latch is dead
* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt fadc_cmp vin vref clk clkb vout voutb vss vdd
* pre-amplifier
XM1 pn vin  s    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
XM2 pp vref s    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
RT  s  vss 8k
RL1 vdd pp 40k
RL2 vdd pn 40k
* isolating pass gates (on while clk = 0)
XG1 pp vout  clk clkb vss vdd fadc_tg
XG2 pn voutb clk clkb vss vdd fadc_tg
* regenerative latch
RL3 vdd vout  40k
RL4 vdd voutb 40k
XM4 vout  voutb ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM5 voutb vout  ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM8 ns clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM9 ns clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CL1 vout  vss 40f
CL2 voutb vss 40f
.ends fadc_cmp

* 8 k string, 225 uA.  tap m sits at 0.72 + 0.0225*m = 0.9 + 0.2*(0.1125*m - 0.9)
* node n8 is the 0.9 V midpoint used by the input attenuators.
RLT vrefp n15 3300
RL14 n15 n14 100
RL13 n14 n13 100
RL12 n13 n12 100
RL11 n12 n11 100
RL10 n11 n10 100
RL9  n10 n9  100
RL8  n9  n8  100

RA1 vinp ap 100

* One flash comparator slice: two matched nmos pairs into a shared
* resistive preamp load, followed by a clocked regenerative latch.
* wp/wn : attenuated input taps (w7, w9)      -> common mode 0.9 V
* rp/rn : fine reference taps (mf16-i, mf i)  -> common mode 0.9 V
* out   : thermometer bit, high while vdiff > 0.225*(i-8)
.subckt cmp_cell vss vdd clk clkb wp wn rp rn out
* preamp load and matched resistive tails
RPL vdd pp 60k
RPN vdd pn 60k
RTI s1 vss 20k
RTR s2 vss 20k
* signal pair
XMI1 pp wp s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
XMI2 pn wn s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
* reference pair (identical devices, identical tail, identical common mode)
XMR1 pp rp s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
XMR2 pn rn s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2.5 nf=1
* regenerative latch: steering pair + cross coupled nmos, pmos load
XML1 out pp ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
XML2 outb pn ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN1 out outb ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMN2 outb out ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMP1 outb out vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMP2 out outb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
* tail: series resistor degenerates the pair, clk nmos switch to vss
RTL ts tr 5k
XTL tr clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
* tail precharge: with ts at vdd the latch is fully off during clk=0, so
* the output precharge is not fighting it and every conversion starts from
* the same state (otherwise the latch holds a data dependent offset).
XTA ts clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
* clkb holds the tail defined across the acquisition/edge overlap
XTP ts clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.42 nf=1
* precharge to vdd while clk=0

XPC2 outb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* dummy inverter keeps the load on outb identical to the load on out
XDL outb dmy vss vdd inv_s
.ends cmp_cell

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (sky130 1.8V devices only).
*
* Architecture:
*  - 16-segment resistor reference ladder between vrefp and vrefn.
*    Tap lr_k sits at vrefn + k/16*(vrefp-vrefn); with 1.8 V across the
*    ladder each step is 0.1125 V.
*  - 15 StrongARM comparators. Comparator j switches at
*    vid = vinp-vinn = 0.225*(j-8) V, i.e. the boundary between codes
*    j-1 and j:
*      j=1..7  : +in = lr(16-j), -in = vinn
*      j=8     : +in = vinp,     -in = lr8
*      j=9..15 : +in = vinp,     -in = lr(j)
*    One comparator input is always a reference tap >= 0.9 V, so an
*    NMOS-input latch works over the full 0.05..1.75 V input range.
*    Sampling happens at the clk rising edge (latch strobe); clk=1 is
*    the conversion phase.
*  - Thermometer -> binary encoder:
*      dout3 = T8
*      dout2 = (T4 & ~T8) | T12
*      dout1 = (T2 & ~T4) | (T6 & ~T8) | (T10 & ~T12) | T14
*      dout0 = T1 xor T2 xor ... xor T15  (parity of the thermometer)
*  - Buffered 4 outputs drive the external pins.

* Logic primitives

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (sky130 1.8 V core devices only).
*
* Architecture:
*   - 16-segment resistor ladder between vrefp and vrefn; tap t_k sits at
*     vrefn + k*(vrefp-vrefn)/16.
*   - 15 comparators. Comparator k resolves (vinp-vinn) > (tap_k - tap_(16-k)),
*     i.e. a differential trip of -1.8 V + k*0.225 V for a 1.8 V reference span.
*   - Each comparator: rail-to-rail preamp (parallel nMOS and pMOS input quads
*     with switched resistive tails) that tracks while clk=0, followed by a
*     StrongARM latch that regenerates on the rising clk edge and holds during
*     clk=1. The preamp tails are open during clk=1, so the sampled
*     differential is held as charge on the preamp output nodes.
*   - Thermometer-to-binary encoder: for a thermometer code with t_k = 1 for
*     k <= code, bit j is the XOR of t_k over multiples k of 2^j.
*
* Primitive examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.subckt xinv in out vdd vss
XNI out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPI out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends xinv

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC, SKY130 1.8 V CMOS.
* - 16-segment resistor ladder vrefp->vrefn provides taps t1..t15.
* - Comparator k compares (vinp - vinn) against t_k - t_(16-k)
*   = 0.225*(k-8) V with a four-device input quad: vinp and t_(16-k)
*   drive side a, vinn and t_k drive side b. Since vinp+vinn = 1.8 V =
*   t_k + t_(16-k) on this bench, the preamplifier balance point is
*   exact for matched devices.
* - Preamplifier integrates during pulse amp, sense-amplifier latch
*   regenerates during pulse le; both pulses derived from clk via RC
*   delays. Latch outputs are buffered on both sides (th, thb).
* - Transmission-gate mux tree encodes the thermometer code.

.subckt inv1 a y vdd vss
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends inv1

.subckt inv2 a y vdd vss
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends inv2

.subckt inv3 a y vdd vss
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2

.ends inv3

.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss

XN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

.ends nor2

* 2:1 mux, y = s ? d1 : d0, transmission-gate implementation.
.subckt mux2 d0 d1 s sb y vdd vss
XT0N d0 sb y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XT0P d0 s y vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

* Two-stage clocked comparator plus static storage latch.
* Preamplifier: PMOS loads PA/PB gated by ampb and tail PT gated by
* amp. While amp is high the input quad settles a/b to its balance
* point; when amp falls, loads and tail cut off and a/b freeze on node
* capacitance for the rest of the conversion.
* Sense latch: during le (inside the amp window) current-starved tail MT
* lets NA/NB discharge precharged nodes c/d slowly enough for the
* strong cross-coupled PMOS pair KA/KB to regenerate the small a/b
* difference into a full-swing c/d state (c low when vinp-vinn is
* below the threshold, c high above it).
* Storage: while le is high, transmission gates copy c/d into the
* cross-coupled inverter pair e/f, which holds the state with zero
* static current and full isolation once le falls. th = buf(e).
.subckt fcmp amp ampb le lei hld hldb clk vinp vinn refp refn th thb vdd vss
XPA a ampb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XPB b ampb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XIN1 a vinp pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XIN2 b vinn pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XRF1 b refn pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XRF2 a refp pt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPT pt amp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XPC c clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPD d clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPS s clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNA c a s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNB d b s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XKA c d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XKB d c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMT s le vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XTGEN c le e vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XTGEP c lei e vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XTGFN d le f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XTGFP d lei f vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
* Storage latch: cross-coupled inverters whose feedback (XTGE/XTGF)
* closes only after le ends (hld), latching the state written from
* c/d. While clk is low, PCE/PCF precharge e/f to vdd so that every
* conversion starts from identical, symmetric initial conditions.
XPCE e clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPCF f clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XSN1 fi e vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.5 nf=1
XSP1 fi e vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XSN2 ei f vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=0.5 nf=1
XSP2 ei f vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XXTFN fi hld f vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XXTFP fi hldb f vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XXTEN ei hld e vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XXTEP ei hldb e vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XE1 e ex vdd vss inv2
XE2 ex th vdd vss inv2
XF1 f fx vdd vss inv2
XF2 fx thb vdd vss inv2
.ends fcmp

.subckt flash_adc_4bit clk dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* Clock buffering and phased internal clocks from the single clk pin.
XCB1 clk cbuf vdd vss inv2
XCB2 cbuf cbuf2 vdd vss inv3
* Dedicated drivers for the two RC delay networks.
XQA cbuf2 clkqa vdd vss inv2
RDA clkqa rca 6.8k
CDA rca vss 0.33p
XQB cbuf2 clkqb vdd vss inv2
RDB clkqb rcb 20k
CDB rcb vss 0.33p

XNA rca na vdd vss inv1
XNB rcb nb vdd vss inv1
* amp = clk AND NOT nb : preamplifier window [edge, ~4.4ns].
XAP cbuf nb ampr vdd vss nor2
XAB1 ampr ampb vdd vss inv1
XAB2 ampb amp vdd vss inv2
* le = amp-window AND na : latch pulse [~1.6ns, ~4.4ns]; lebn = NOT le.
XLE ampr na len vdd vss nand2
XL1 len lew vdd vss inv1
XL2 lew lebn vdd vss inv2
XL3 lebn le vdd vss inv3
* hld = clk AND nb : closes the storage-latch feedback right after le
* ends (nb is the same tap that terminates amp/le) until clk falls.
XHLD cbuf rcb hldr vdd vss nor2
XH1 hldr hldw vdd vss inv1
XH2 hldw hld vdd vss inv3
XH3 hldw hldb vdd vss inv2

RL4 t13 t12 1k
RL5 t12 t11 1k
RL6 t11 t10 1k
RL7 t10 t9 1k
RL8 t9 t8 1k
RL9 t8 t7 1k

XC1 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t15 t1 th1 th1b vdd vss fcmp
XC2 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t14 t2 th2 th2b vdd vss fcmp
XC3 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t13 t3 th3 th3b vdd vss fcmp
XC4 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t12 t4 th4 th4b vdd vss fcmp
XC5 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t11 t5 th5 th5b vdd vss fcmp

XC12 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t4 t12 th12 th12b vdd vss fcmp

XC15 amp ampb le lebn hld hldb clk vinp vinn t1 t15 th15 th15b vdd vss fcmp
* Thermometer-to-binary encoder (mux tree).
XM12 th2 th6 th4 th4b n12 vdd vss mux2
XM13 th10 th14 th12 th12b n13 vdd vss mux2
XM14 n12 n13 th8 th8b b1 vdd vss mux2
XM24 th4 th12 th8 th8b b2 vdd vss mux2

XM02 th5 th7 th6 th6b n02 vdd vss mux2
XM03 th9 th11 th10 th10b n03 vdd vss mux2
XM04 th13 th15 th14 th14b n04 vdd vss mux2
XM05 n01 n02 th4 th4b n05 vdd vss mux2
XM06 n03 n04 th12 th12b n06 vdd vss mux2
XM07 n05 n06 th8 th8b b0 vdd vss mux2
* Output drivers.
XD3A th8 m3 vdd vss inv2
XD3B m3 dout3 vdd vss inv3
XD2A b2 m2 vdd vss inv2
XD2B m2 dout2 vdd vss inv3
XD1A b1 m1 vdd vss inv2
XD1B m1 dout1 vdd vss inv3
XD0A b0 m0 vdd vss inv2

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (1.8 V, 27 C, nominal TT)
*
* Architecture
*   - 16-segment equal resistor ladder between vrefp and vrefn.
*   - 15 identical clocked comparators.  A passive averaging network forms
*       ap = (vinp + vrn)/2,   an = (vinn + vrp)/2
*     ap-an = ((vinp-vinn) - (vrp-vrn))/2 at constant 0.9 V common mode.
*     A dynamic latch with cross-coupled PMOS pair regenerates on the
*     rising clk edge, and a NAND SR latch then holds the decision for
*     the remainder of the cycle.
*   - Static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder and output inverters.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS logic primitives
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt scl_inv a y vss vdd
xp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends scl_inv

.subckt scl_nand2 a b y vss vdd
xp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xn1 y a ni vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xn2 ni b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends scl_nand2

.subckt scl_nand3 a b c y vss vdd
xp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xp3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xn1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
xn2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
xn3 n2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends scl_nand3

.subckt scl_nand4 a b c d y vss vdd
xp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xp3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
xp4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

xn2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
xn3 n2 c n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
xn4 n3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends scl_nand4

.subckt scl_nor2 a b y vss vdd
xp1 y a p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
xp2 p1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

xn2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends scl_nor2

.subckt scl_nor4 a b c d y vss vdd
xp1 y a p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
xp2 p1 b p2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
xp3 p2 c p3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
xp4 p3 d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
xn1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
xn2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1

.ends scl_or4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clocked dynamic regeneration stage
*   clk low : sp, sn precharged to vdd
*   clk high: higher input gate pulls its own node down; the cross PMOS pair
*             cuts the winning (high) node, leaving full rail separation
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt fa_dynlatch inp inn clk sp sn vss vdd
xpp sp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
xpn sn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
xip sp inp tx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
xin sn inn tx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=2 nf=1
xit tx clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
xcp1 sp sn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
xcp2 sn sp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
.ends fa_dynlatch

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NAND SR latch: with dynamic nodes (sp,sn), q=1 when sp=0,sn=1
*   q  = NAND(sp, qb)
*   qb = NAND(sn, q)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt fa_srlatch sp sn q qb vss vdd
x1 sp qb q vss vdd scl_nand2
x2 sn q qb vss vdd scl_nand2
.ends fa_srlatch

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* One complete differential comparator
*   ap = (vinp+vrn)/2, an = (vinn+vrp)/2 via equal averaging resistors
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt fa_comparator clk vinp vinn vrp vrn q qb vss vdd
ra1 vinp ap 500k
ra2 vrn  ap 500k
ra3 vinn an 500k
ra4 vrp  an 500k
xdl ap an clk sp sn vss vdd fa_dynlatch
xsr sp sn q qb vss vdd fa_srlatch
.ends fa_comparator

* Four-input fully-differential summing comparator.
* Pins: inp inn = held differential input, rp rn = differential reference.

* out=1 when inp-inn > rp-rn. vbn = fixed tail bias.
.subckt comp4 vss vdd inp inn rp rn vbn out

* Stage 2: nmos differential pair with pmos current-mirror load,

* flash_adc_4bit : 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (sky130, 1.8 V)
*
* Architecture
*   1. 16-segment resistor ladder from vrefp to vrefn produces taps
*      t1..t15 at (vrefp-vrefn)*j/16, i.e. 0.1125*j V for a 1.8 V reference.
*      Each tap carries a 160 fF bypass capacitor: the comparator quad
*      drains swing rail-to-rail every conversion, and the capacitors keep
*      the resulting Cgd kickback from displacing the tap voltages during
*      the decision (otherwise every threshold shifts ~0.2 LSB away from
*      mid-scale and INL/DNL degrade).
*   2. 15 parallel dynamic comparators (subckt sacmp). Each has a 4-input
*      NMOS quad with a common source node and cross-connected drains:
*         pair 1:  gate vinp  -> drain node B (complement side)
*                  gate tp    -> drain node A (true side)
*         pair 2:  gate vinn  -> drain node A (true side)
*                  gate tn    -> drain node B (complement side)
*      Comparator i uses tp = t_i and tn = t_(16-i), so tp+tn = vrefp+vrefn.
*      Each pair is internally symmetric, so its differential current is
*      exactly zero when its two gate voltages are equal; the comparator
*      trips exactly at (vinp-vinn) = (tp-tn), independent of common mode
*      and of which pair is actually conducting.  Comparator i therefore
*      trips at vinp = t_i (equivalently vinn = t_(16-i)).
*      clk=0 is the reset phase: outputs, quad drains AND the tail node are
*      all precharged to vdd, so every device is off and each conversion
*      starts from an identical, history-free state (no hysteresis).  On
*      the rising edge a narrow current-limited tail discharges the tail
*      node, the quad integrates a differential voltage across CNA/CNB on
*      the quad drains, and the cross-coupled pair XMN1/XMN2 regenerates it
*      differentially onto outT/outC (sources ride on the quad drains, so
*      the resolved outputs have no residual pull-down path: no static
*      current during clk=1).  Both clock phases come from the single clk
*      pin.
*   3. Every comparator output drives one identical inverter, so all 30
*      latch nodes see exactly the same capacitive load.
*   4. One-hot thermometer-to-binary encoder built from NAND2 / NAND4 /
*      NOR2 / inverters. q_i = thermometer bit i (high = input above t_i).
*      With wq_k = NOT q_k and wqb_k = q_k (the buffer outputs):
*         one-hot:  oh_k = q_k AND NOT q_(k+1), so n_k = NAND(wqb_k, wq_(k+1))
*                   (k = 1..14),  oh_15 = q_15
*         dout0 = OR(oh 1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15)  dout1 = OR(oh 2,3,6,7,10,11,14,15)
*         dout2 = OR(oh 4,5,6,7,12,13,14,15) dout3 = q_8
*      A 4-input OR is formed as NAND4 of the inverted one-hot lines,
*      combined pairwise with NOR2 and a final output buffer.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- logic
.subckt inv a y vdd vss

XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---------------------------------------------------------- comparator
* Dynamic comparator with a current-limited input integrator and a
* source-followed regenerative latch.
*   outT = high  when (vinp-vinn) > (tp-tn)
* Reset (clk low) precharges the outputs, the quad drain nodes na/nb AND
* the tail node ns to vdd: every device is off, no current flows, and each
* conversion starts from an identical state (no hysteresis).
* On the rising edge the tail discharges ns, the quad integrates a
* differential voltage on na/nb (CNA/CNB set the integration time so the
* latch commits before the quad enters triode), and the cross-coupled
* pair XMN1/XMN2 regenerates it onto outT/outC.  After resolution the
* winning output has no pull-down path left, so the comparator draws no
* static current during the conversion phase.

* ============================================================================
* flash_adc_4bit : 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (SKY130, 1.8 V)
*
* Interface (fixed):
*   clk        external sampling clock; clk=0 acquisition, rising edge ends
*              sampling, clk=1 conversion.  Complementary/sample timing is
*              generated internally.
*   dout3..0   binary output, dout3 = MSB, valid from ~2 ns after the edge
*              and held through the remainder of the cycle.
*   vinn vinp  differential input, 0.9 V common mode, +-1.7 V differential.
*   vrefn/vrefp reference endpoints (0 .. 1.8 V).
*
* Architecture
*   1. 16x500 ohm resistor ladder vrefp->vrefn, tap k sits at 0.1125*k V.
*      Comparator k (k=1..15) uses tap pair tp=rk, tn=r(16-k) so that
*      tp+tn = 1.8 V = vinp+vinn and tp-tn = 0.225*(k-8) V, i.e. the ideal
*      transition levels -1.575 .. +1.575 V in 0.225 V differential steps.
*   2. 15 dynamic double-differential comparators.  Four identical input
*      devices share one tail node; because vinp+vinn = tp+tn, the net
*      differential discharge current has the sign of (vinp-vinn)-(tp-tn)
*      for any monotonic device law, so the trip point is exact at TT.
*   3. A one-shot driven by clk creates an internal ~3.6 ns evaluation
*      pulse (clki).  Comparators are reset (clki=0) for the rest of the
*      cycle, which removes evaluation-phase shoot-through current.
*   4. Each comparator feeds a static SR latch that holds the thermometer
*      bit from ~1 ns after the edge until the next conversion.
*   5. One-hot NAND thermometer-to-binary encoder:
*      nh_m = NAND(T_m, ~T_m+1), dout_b = NAND8 of the eight nh_m whose
*      code m has bit b set (m=15 term is ~T_15 directly).
* ============================================================================

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* static CMOS helpers
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

* inverter
.subckt fadc_inv zo zi vdd vss
XMP zo zi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMN zo zi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
.ends fadc_inv

* two-stage non-inverting buffer for the internal comparator clock
.subckt fadc_clkbuf zo zi vdd vss
XB1P zn zi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=1
XB1N zn zi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XB2P zo zn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=11 nf=2
XB2N zo zn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.5 nf=2
.ends fadc_clkbuf

* 2-input NAND
.subckt fadc_nand2 zo a b vdd vss
XMPA zo a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMPB zo b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMNA nza a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
XMNB zo b nza vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.7 nf=1
.ends fadc_nand2

* 2-input NOR
.subckt fadc_nor2 zo a b vdd vss
XMPA nza a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1

.ends fadc_nor2

* 8-input NAND: zo = NOT(a AND b AND ... AND h)
.subckt fadc_nand8 zo a b c d e f g h vdd vss

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* dynamic double-differential comparator
*   evaluate while clki high: x falls (y stays high) when
*   (vinp - vinn) > (tp - tn).  Reset while clki low: x = y = vdd.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt fadc_cmp x y vinp vinn tp tn clki vdd vss
* reset precharge of the two latch nodes
XMPR1 x clki vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMPR2 y clki vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
* regenerative cross-coupled PMOS latch: the node that lags is restored
* to vdd, the node that leads falls to ~cs.  Deliberately no cross-
* coupled NMOS pair: the latch nodes are discharged by the input quad
* alone, so the seed of the decision is exactly the input difference.
XMP3 x y vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMP4 y x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* double-differential input stage: four identical devices, common source cs
XMSP x vinp cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMSN y vinn cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMRN x tn   cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
XMRP y tp   cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1 nf=1
* evaluation tail switch
XMT cs clki vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.3 w=4 nf=1
.ends fadc_cmp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* slave SR latch: q = T bit (set when x falls), reset when y falls,
* holds while x = y = vdd (comparator in reset).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt fadc_slat q qb x y vdd vss
XIVS qs x vdd vss fadc_inv
XIVR rs y vdd vss fadc_inv
XNQ  q  rs qb vdd vss fadc_nor2
XNQB qb qs q  vdd vss fadc_nor2
.ends fadc_slat

* Four-input double-tail strong-arm comparator.
* Regenerates outp high when (vinp - vinn) > (refp - refn).

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (SKY130, 1.8 V, 27 C).
* Architecture: 16-tap reference ladder, 15 dual-input-pair StrongARM
* comparators (fully differential thresholds), transistor-level
* thermometer-to-binary XOR encoder.
*
* Comparator j trips when (vinp - vinn) > (n_j - n_(16-j)), where n_j is
* ladder tap j at j*(vrefp-vrefn)/16.  Summing the currents of the two
* input pairs makes the threshold exact by symmetry and keeps the input
* stage alive over the full common-mode range.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS inverter
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmos_inv a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends cmos_inv

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS 2-input XOR (12 transistors incl. input inverters)
* y = a ^ b
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmos_xor2 a b y vss vdd
XINA a an vss vdd cmos_inv
XINB b bn vss vdd cmos_inv
* pull-down: conducts when a == b
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN3 y an n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN4 n2 bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
* pull-up: conducts when a != b
XMP1 y a p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP2 y b p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP3 p1 an vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP4 p1 bn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends cmos_xor2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Dual-input-pair StrongARM comparator.
* t = 1 when (vinp - vinn) > (refp - refn).
* clk = 0 : reset (x, y, outn, outp pulled to vdd, x-y equalized by clkb)
* clk = 1 : regenerate
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt comp4 clk clkb vinp vinn refp refn t vss vdd
* clocked tail (weak: slows the preamp discharge so the input current
* difference integrates into a large x/y time separation)
XMTAIL s clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
* input pair A: vinp vs refp
XMIN1 x vinp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMIN2 y refp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* input pair B: refn vs vinn
XMIN3 x refn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMIN4 y vinn s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* preamp reset (clk=0: x=y=vdd)
XMR1 x clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMR2 y clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* integration caps
CX x vss 25f
CY y vss 25f
* threshold inverters: sx/sy rise as x/y fall below mid-rail
XIVX x sx vss vdd cmos_inv
XIVY y sy vss vdd cmos_inv
* NAND SR latch: captures whichever of sx/sy rises first.
* reset state (clk=0): sx=sy=0 -> outn=outp=1
XNA1 outn sx vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNA2 outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNA3 outn sx nna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XNA4 nna outp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XNB1 outp sy vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNB2 outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNB3 outp sy nnb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XNB4 nnb outn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
* output equalizer during acquisition (uses complementary clock)
XMEQ outn clkb outp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* t follows outp: t=1 when the x side (vinp+refn) discharged first
XIB1 outp tb vss vdd cmos_inv
XIB2 tb t vss vdd cmos_inv
.ends comp4

* Tracks (vinp,vinn) on phi_acq into caps that also subtract the ladder
* reference on phi_conv, then regenerates. Buffered outputs isolate the
* latch from encoder loading.
* th=1 when (vinp-vinn) > (vrefa-vrefb)

* sampling capacitors (1pF)
CP nbotp inp 1p
CN nbotn inn 1p
* input track transmission gates (acquisition)

XPP vinp phi_acq_b nbotp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XNB vrefb phi_conv nbotn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

XPREP_P inp phi_acq_b vpre vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

XMPP outp phi_acq_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPN outn phi_acq_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* equalize outputs during acquisition
XEQ outp phi_acq outn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* cross-coupled PMOS (positive feedback, off when both outputs high)
XMXP outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMXN outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XBP2 tp1 th vss vdd minv

XBN2 tn1 thb vss vdd minv
.ends samp_cmp

* 4-bit fully differential flash ADC, 50 MS/s, 1.8 V, sky130.
* clk=0 acquisition, rising edge samples, clk=1 conversion.
* Complementary sample clock is generated internally from clk.
*
* Each comparator sees resistively averaged inputs
*   gp = (vinp + vlo)/2,  gn = (vinn + vhi)/2
* so the differential pair voltage is (vid - T)/2 at 0.9 V common mode.
* StrongARM latches the sign to a thermometer bit; static NAND XOR
* tree converts the thermometer to binary.

* ---------------- building blocks ----------------

* Design: 16-rung reference ladder, 15 static low-offset comparators with
* resistor-summed differential thresholds, thermometer-to-binary word-line NOR

* (X-Y) proportional to (vp-vn) - (rp-rn).  With matched devices and a shared

* device threshold or absolute input level.  The clocked latch samples the
* (always settled) preamplifier outputs and regenerates to rail-to-rail on
* the rising edge of clk, so there is no reset-state race to bias it.
* out is HIGH when (vp-vn) > (rp-rn).

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully-differential flash ADC, sky130_fd_pr__01v8, 1.8 V.
* Differential inputs at 0.9 V common mode; clk=0 acquire, rising edge latches,
* clk=1 conversion. Outputs dout3..dout0 valid >0.9 V = 1 at edge+9 ns.
* Reference ladder vrefn(0)..vrefp(1.8) produces 16 taps a_k = 0.1125*k.
*
* Each of the 15 comparators uses a shared-source folded differential pair:
* pair A (inp, refm) and pair B (refp, inn) summing currents into resistor
* loads.  The folding keeps every gate in the 0.9 V common-mode region over
* the full input range; at the trip point the comparison reduces to
* vinp-vinn = refm-refp, so thresholds track the ladder to <0.1 LSB (the
* empirical trip of a well-biased shared-source pair is within 0.07 LSB of
* ideal).  The static preamp output feeds a clocked cross-coupled-PMOS latch
* that regenerates full-swing pk/nk within a few ns of the rising edge.

* 4-bit 50 MS/s fully differential flash ADC (sky130 CMOS)
*
* Architecture
*   - 16-tap ideal resistor ladder between vrefn and vrefp gives the fifteen
*     differential comparison levels (tap j vs tap 16-j).
*   - Fifteen identical capacitive-sampling dynamic comparators.  During clk=0
*     the sampling caps sit on vinp/vinn with their top plates precharged to
*     the ladder mid-scale bias; the top-plate switch opens on the clk rising
*     edge so the input is sampled exactly there, then the bottom plates are
*     switched to the ladder taps, producing a differential
*     k*(threshold - vin_diff) at the comparator input.
*   - clk low = acquisition, clk rising edge = end of sampling, clk high =
*     conversion.  The complementary and a delayed clock are generated
*     locally so the sampling break-before-make order is guaranteed.
*   - Thermometer-to-binary encoding is done with static CMOS gates.

* 4-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC (nominal TT, 1.8 V, 27 C)
* 16-resistor string references (taps at (16-k) * 0.1125 V).
* Per threshold: an nFET-input latch (valid when an input exceeds Vth)
* plus a pFET-input latch (valid when an input is below vdd-|Vth|).
* A 0.7 V validity detector selects the latch that is in strong inversion,
* so the combined decision is correct over the full rail-to-rail range.
* XOR-tree thermometer-to-binary encoder.
* clk = 0 : acquisition / precharge (outputs pulled low).
* clk = 1 : conversion (latches resolve).

* ratioed inverter: threshold ~0.7 V -> output high iff input > 0.7 V
.subckt inv7 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends inv7

* static CMOS inverter
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv

* 2-input NAND gate
.subckt nand2 a b out vss vdd
XN1 out a xn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN2 xn b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand2

* 2-input XOR gate from four NANDs
.subckt xor2 a b out vss vdd
XW a b w vss vdd nand2
XX a w x vss vdd nand2
XY b w y vss vdd nand2
XZ x y out vss vdd nand2
.ends xor2

* nFET-input latched comparator: out high iff vinp > tap (when valid).
* outputs are pulled low during clk=0 and resolve during clk=1.
.subckt latchn clk clkn vinp tap xn vss vdd
XP1 outp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 xn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XM1 outp vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM2 xn tap tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends latchn

* pFET-input latched comparator: out high iff vinp > tap (when valid).
.subckt latchp clk clkn vinp tap xp vss vdd
XP1 outp clkn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XP2 outn clkn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XLN1 outp xp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLN2 xp outp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1

.ends latchp

* b = xn when max(vinp,tap) > 0.7, otherwise b = xp (T-gate MUX)
.subckt sel xn xp useN useNb b vss vdd

.ends sel
